Weekly WIP

I had so many puns about goblin girls with gold coins in their asses I couldn`t choose just one!

-She`s heavy with interest!
-Now, that`s a real treasure booty!
-She went from cumsock to gold pocket!
-Later she will be a gold digger.
-Pikka, the golden ass-ets goblin
-Those are some backdoor investments
-Filling the piggy-bank
-So much for the tail-deposit!
-It`s the first coin-operated goblin

...etc etc
